content:
Kibo covers commerce and order management on one data model, headless storefront APIs, real-time network-wide inventory, intelligent order routing, search and personalization, and B2B workflows built in, quoting, contract pricing, EDI, offline order creation.

In this issue

  • The agentic story. Kibo's agentic story stands on two shipped pieces, an MCP server and a suite of commerce agents.
  • Strengths. The OMS heritage is the strength my MOM years taught me to appreciate.
  • Cautions. The reference base is thin where it counts for this series.
  • Who it is for, and who it is not for. For, a North American mid-market retailer or distributor that wants agent-ready composable commerce with order management as the source of truth, without top-tier pricing.
  • Verdict. My readiness score, and I will flag that this one is scored on paper.
